findings.message: Login route 'login' (GET login) has no throttle middleware — brute-force attacks unmitigated. Add ->middleware('throttle:5,1').
Login route 'two-factor.login' (GET two-factor-challenge) has no throttle middleware — brute-force attacks unmitigated. Add ->middleware('throttle:5,1').
OTP/2FA route two-factor-challenge has no throttle middleware — brute-force protection missing. Add ->middleware('throttle:6,1').
OTP/2FA route user/two-factor-qr-code has no throttle middleware — brute-force protection missing. Add ->middleware('throttle:6,1').
OTP/2FA route user/two-factor-secret-key has no throttle middleware — brute-force protection missing. Add ->middleware('throttle:6,1').
OTP/2FA route user/two-factor-recovery-codes has no throttle middleware — brute-force protection missing. Add ->middleware('throttle:6,1').
User model in app/Models/User.php doesn't appear to mark 'password' as hidden or use the 'hashed' cast — verify password storage is hashed and not exposed in API responses.
Email verification route 'verification.notice' (verify-email) is missing 'signed' middleware — URL parameters can be tampered with.
Email verification route 'verification.verify' (verify-email/{id}/{hash}) is missing 'signed' middleware — URL parameters can be tampered with.
